create.title: Exact product-wavelet reduction of the fixed-interior reciprocal cone
create.statement_tex: Let T=sqrt(X/N), V be fixed smooth compactly supported in (0,infinity), Xi be fixed smooth compactly supported in (0,1), g(t)=1_(t>0)V(t^2)/t, and K=hat(g). Then the fixed-interior reciprocal cone R=sum_(h,j>=1)chi_4(j)Xi(j/sqrt(X))h^(-1)V(4Xh^2/(j^2N))e(Xh/j) equals sum_(n>=1)A_(X,Xi)(n)K((n-X)/(2T))+O_B(X^(-B)), where A_(X,Xi)(n)=sum_(j|n)chi_4(j)Xi(j/sqrt(X)). All continuous moments of K vanish; once 2T exceeds the support radius of g, sum_(n in Z)(n-X)^r K((n-X)/(2T))=0 for every r>=0. Exact products survive through K(0)A_(X,Xi)(X). Inverse Poisson reconstructs R exactly. The absolute product ledger is O_epsilon(TX^epsilon), so the target O(X^(1/4+epsilon)) needs X^(1/4-nu/2), equal to H/L at D=sqrt(X), L=sqrt(N), H=X^(1/4). The signed estimate and sharp saddle/full-cone completion remain open.
create.next_action: Prove a signed short-product discrepancy estimate for A_(X,Xi) gaining H/L, then separately recover the sharp j=sqrt(X) saddle, lower j scales, entry/exit, negative frequencies, and subtraction.

update.next_action: The fixed-interior subcritical cone is now an exact product wavelet. Prove the H/L signed local discrepancy and complete the omitted saddle/transitions; zero moments and another Poisson transform self-return.
Use the product-wavelet kernel as a separable test case at the exact PSC scale. A proof must gain H/L on the moving truncated divisor coefficient; it does not automatically prove full PSC.

reject.reason: Continuous and sampled polynomial moments vanish, but the moving truncated divisor coefficient is atomic; bounded adversarial coefficients can align with the wavelet and attain length T.
K(0)=one half integral V(u)du/u is generally nonzero. Exact products survive but are divisor-bounded and target-safe.
Inverse Poisson reconstructs the original reciprocal h-sum with the exact phase and measure.

Audited sources require additive shifts and complete automorphic coefficients, modular inverses and coprimality, or provide only a transformation; none matches the moving truncated divisor coefficient and product window.
The fixed Xi cutoff omits lower j scales, the sharp j=sqrt(X) half-saddle, stationary transitions, negative frequencies, and subtraction/boundary recombination.

no_change.reason: The signed product discrepancy and full cone remain open.
Round 64 proves a reduction and no-go, not a radial estimate or exponent.

round_assessment.reason: Round 64 exposes an exact zero-moment product wavelet and the precise H/L arithmetic discrepancy still required, while proving that another Poisson step self-returns. No analytic saving or exponent is proved.
